prompt: On a new server setup, Lisa realizes that the SSH daemon is listening on port `2222` instead of the default port `22`. To confirm this, she decides to check the `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` file. Which line should she look for to verify the port number on which the SSH daemon is listening?
explanation: The `Port` directive in `/etc/ssh/sshd_config` specifies the port number on which the SSH daemon listens for connections.
